items.t: Rio Tinto (LSE:RIO) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Mixed Analyst Target Changes
items.sum: Rio Tinto Group is back in focus after analysts adjusted their price targets around a slightly higher fair value estimate of £76.98, up from £75.37. The shift comes alongside research that keeps ratings broadly balanced, with some analysts trimming targets in the £6,500 to £8,800 range, while others point to firmer iron ore expectations and battery metal exposure as support for current valuations.

items.t: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) Commits $250 Million To Panguna Mine Remediation
items.sum: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) has agreed to commit $250 million toward addressing legacy impacts at the Panguna mine in Bougainville. The funding is earmarked for environmental clean up, social programs, and human rights remediation linked to the former copper gold operation. items.t: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) Restarts Tiwai Point Capacity, Is The Valuation Gap Too Wide?
items.sum: Rio Tinto Group (LSE:RIO) is back in the headlines after agreeing a three and a half year, 50MW electricity deal that will restart Line 4 at New Zealand’s Tiwai Point aluminium smelter, restoring full capacity. items.t: Rio Tinto to Restart Line 4 Operations With 50MW Electricity Contract
items.sum: RIO's 50MW electricity deal with Contact Energy paves the way for Line 4's restart, boosting aluminium output by 30,000 tons annually.

items.t: BHP, Rio Tinto executives to meet Chinese leaders amid iron ore tensions
items.sum: Investing.com-- Executives from BHP (ASX:BHP) and Rio Tinto (ASX:RIO) will meet Chinese Premier Li Qiang and business leaders in Beijing on Friday, alongside Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, as tensions over iron ore pricing and supply negotiations test economic ties between the two countries.
